# F&F Oil Solutions

> Give your oil a second life. On-site oil filtration, vacuum dehydration and reclamation, plus oil flushing, oil sampling and analysis, and hydraulic leak inspection and repair for industrial facilities. Based in the Rio Grande Valley, Texas. English and Spanish.

- General inquiries: info@ffoilsolutions.com
- Direct contact: Fernando Armenta, fernandoarmenta@ffoilsolutions.com
- Website (English): https://ffoilsolutions.com/
- Website (Spanish): https://ffoilsolutions.com/es/

## Services
- Oil filtration, vacuum dehydration and reclamation: Particle filtration and vacuum dehydration to treat suitable hydraulic and lubricating oils on site.
- Oil flushing: Circulation of a compatible fluid through an agreed system or circuit using filtration equipment to remove particles and residual contamination.
- Hydraulic leak inspection and repair: Inspection of hoses, fittings, connections, seals and accessible components, with repair scope defined with the maintenance team.
- Oil sampling and analysis: Visual inspection, patch testing and laboratory analysis: ISO 4406 particle count, Karl Fischer water, viscosity at 40 C, TAN, FTIR and ICP.
- Ongoing oil care programs: Scheduled sampling, oil condition reviews, filtration or dehydration when indicated, and follow-up on leak repair needs.

## Industries
Manufacturing and metalworking; plastics, injection molding and recycling; die casting and foundries; oil and gas; refineries and petrochemical facilities; concrete, cement and aggregates; heavy equipment and industrial support.

## Notes
A pre-treatment oil assessment is required. Not all used oil can be restored; suitability depends on oil condition, contamination, additive health and equipment requirements. Results vary by oil condition and application.
